templates.title: Silicate Requisition Order — Batch 4-7A
templates.text: The Bureau requires raw silicates for redistribution to ISA-contracted construction projects. Mine the quota from any active extraction lease and deliver it to the Bureau when you have it.

templates.title: Nickel Freight Manifest — Consignment 9-2B
templates.text: The Bureau has flagged a shortfall of nickel across ISA-administered construction depots. Deliver nickel to fulfil this standing requisition order.

templates.title: Carbon Fibre Supply Run — Priority C
templates.text: Station maintenance divisions require a resupply of carbon for composite fabrication. Source and deliver to the contracting office.

templates.title: Helium-3 Emergency Allocation — Directive 77
templates.text: Reactor fuel reserves are approaching critical minimums. The ISA has issued a priority directive: deliver Helium-3 to the Bureau for immediate redistribution to power infrastructure.

templates.title: Titanium Structural Allotment — Frame Series 12
templates.text: Station expansion projects require titanium for structural framework assembly. Deliver to satisfy this standing allotment.

templates.title: Water Ice Procurement — Habitat Sustainment
templates.text: Life-support divisions have requisitioned water ice for processing into potable reserves. Standard sustainment contract — deliver to the Bureau at your earliest.

templates.title: Rare Earths Acquisition — R&D Allocation
templates.text: The ISA's applied sciences division has requested rare earth elements for experimental fabrication. Extraction difficulty is noted — compensation reflects the challenge.

templates.title: Lithium Cell Stockpile — Battery Reserve
templates.text: Energy storage facilities need lithium for next-generation battery cell production. Source and deliver to the contracting office to fulfil this standing order.

templates.title: Cobalt Shipment — Alloy Programme
templates.text: The metallurgy division requires cobalt for high-temperature alloy production. Deliver to satisfy the current programme quota.

templates.title: Thorium Fuel Rods — Reactor Consignment
templates.text: Next-generation reactor trials require thorium. The ISA has authorised a premium-rate contract delivered to the Bureau. Handle with appropriate caution.

agents.bio:
Coordinator Voss has served the ISA's logistics division for over fourteen years, beginning as a junior freight auditor on Luna Gateway before transferring to Earth Station Prime's newly established Contracting & Assignments Bureau. She earned her Senior Coordinator designation after managing the emergency redistribution of silicate reserves during the Ceres Supply Crisis of 2139 — an operation that required coordinating seventeen independent mining corporations under a 72-hour ISA directive.

Her management style is precise, documented, and unapologetically procedural. Contractors who deliver what they sign for, to specification, earn her trust, and she keeps count.

She maintains a small but well-organised office on Deck 7 of the Bureau. The filing cabinets are alphabetised. The coffee is adequate. The contracts are real.
dialogue: Good. You're here. I have contracts that need competent operators — not speculators who think logistics is a side business.
The ISA needs resources moved, extracted, and delivered to specification. If you can handle that, we'll get along fine.

Review the available contracts below. Each one has a quota and a reward. Deliver the quota to me and you'll be paid; every contract you complete raises your standing with me. Walk away from one and it costs you nothing but the standing you would have earned.
